retrievalProfile.description: A centered square portrait framed by a wide solid-color border with stacked, light-weight geometric typography at the top center.
triggerTerms: centered square photo with top-aligned text
excludeWhen: modern minimalist white space is required
dynamic or diagonal layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square photographic portrait is inset within a larger square field of solid mustard yellow. The typography is centered in the upper margin, featuring a thin-stroke geometric sans-serif font. The overall image has a warm, analog grain and high-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm monochromatic border vs. full-color photographic inset
High-contrast facial lighting against a dark background within the photo
coreInvariants: Solid mustard yellow border framing all four sides of the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a close-up portrait centered horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the total canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photographic square acts as the primary anchor, supported by the top-centered text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-centered text, moves down to the subject's eyes, and then rests on the overall framed composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space is provided by the wide, solid-color margins surrounding the central image.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark hair (within the photo)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and bright blue eye highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border; high contrast and warm values in the central photograph.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the upper margin above the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with slight variations in size for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s geometric aesthetic and thin stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image of a woman's face in a 1970s grainy film style with high-contrast lighting, then place this square in the center of a larger mustard-yellow square canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text in the top margin using a hairline geometric sans-serif font in dark brown.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered in the top margin?
Is the central photo a perfect square?
Is the border color a consistent mustard yellow?
Is the font weight extremely light?

postGenerationChecks: Check for centered alignment of all elements
Verify the mustard yellow hue is not too bright or neon
Ensure the photographic grain is visible but not distracting
Confirm the font is a thin geometric sans-serif
recipe.reuseFormula: Square portrait + Wide solid border + Top-centered hairline geometric type = 1970s Folk-Pop Aesthetic
